title: Moravinandan Shyam Baba
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing

scenes.prompt: Young warrior Barbarika, the future Khatu Shyam ji, riding a graceful blue horse across a glowing golden evening plain, three arrows at his side, a bow on his shoulder, calm serene face, peacock feather glowing on his crown, soft sunset light.
scenes.tts: नीले घोड़े पर सवार, मोरवीनंदन श्याम बाबा।
scenes.sub: Neele ghode par sawaar, Moravinandan Shyam Baba.

scenes.prompt: A loving scene of Barbarika bowing to his mother Maurvi in a peaceful ashram courtyard, his father Ghatotkacha and grandfather Bhima standing proudly behind in warm lamplight, gentle devotional mood.
scenes.tts: घटोत्कच के लाल, भीम के पौत्र, माँ मौर्वी के वीर पुत्र।
scenes.sub: Ghatotkach ke laal, Bhim ke pautra, Maa Maurvi ke veer putra.

scenes.prompt: Divine darshan of Khatu Shyam ji, dark-complexioned serene face with a gentle smile, peacock feather crown, flower garlands, glowing diyas all around, soft golden aura, devotees with folded hands in the background.
scenes.tts: हारे का सहारा, बाबा श्याम हमारा।
scenes.sub: Haare ka sahara, Baba Shyam hamara.

scenes.tts: जय श्री श्याम! लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें।
